title: Handover elements
description: elements.json in a frozen item handover (a work item's, ROADMAP slice 24). Same as designc.handover.elements/1, plus in_scope on every element: true for the elements the work item changes. A whole-model handover keeps /1.

elements.description: Every element of the model, in model order.

id.description: Hierarchical: the names from the software system down, joined by '/' (System/Container/Component). A person is its name.

code.description: d.code: where this element's code lives, as normalised repo path patterns (docs/path-patterns.json). Present only when declared.

risk.description: d.risk: how risky a change here is. Present only when declared, and always present when code is (designc refuses d.code without d.risk, DC000).

in_scope.description: True for an element the work item changes. The agent works only these; it asks (needs_decision with element) before touching any other.

relationships.description: Model relationships by element id, one per ordered pair.

events.description: Event names announced in behaviour/*.p (`announce <Name>`), by file path then first appearance, each once.

reserved.description: Repo path patterns no code change may touch: the generated acceptance specs (ROADMAP slices 30 and 31). A coding agent never writes here; the pipeline records acceptance results per criterion at a commit.
